title: •Sacrifice
caption: •Sacrifice (V)
game_text: If opponent just initiated a battle, target your non-{alter} Effect on table. Draw destiny. Place target on Used Pile and activate up to X Force if destiny < X, where X = target’s destiny number.
lore: Jabba’s minions could be expected to be sacrificed to save the Hutt, to destroy one of the Hutts enemies or to provide the Hutt and his minions with a good laugh.
copyright: © LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 1998 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Banner USED INTERRUPT (printed also a Used Interrupt). Inline red circle-slash A after 'non-' → {alter} (stub: '(Immune to Alter)'). Curly apostrophe in target’s. Base card is Special Edition (1998), SE-style copyright line; not legible at 350 px. Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophe in Jabba’s; 'Hutts enemies' (no apostrophe) kept as printed — it is a Decipher typo on the card, not a wiki error. Base scan only at 350 px. Modern: VB3 -pre (350) only.
